senses.gloss: f. (v. צָנַן) stinging palm, stone-palm (whose wood is very hard and thorny).—Pl. צִנִּים, צִנִּין, צִי׳.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:9:2">Y. B. Mets. II, end, 8ᵈ</cite> <he>קורדום … לא צ׳ ועצי זית</he> if one finds an axe, he may use it for chopping ordinary wood, but not for stone-palms and olive trees; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:22">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 22</cite> <cite ref="R00634"><he>צנם</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="R00610"><he>צנון</he></cite>, read: <cite ref="R00607"><he>צנה</he></cite> or <he>צנין</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:1">Succ. III, 1</cite> <he>צִינֵּי … כשרות</he> the palms of the Iron Mount are fit (for the festive wreath), expl.
